cohort: Patients operated on for intestinal obstruction with at least one abdominal surgical scar at Khawaja Muhammad Safdar Medical College, Sialkot, between June 2010 and November 2015, with a minimum 6-month follow-up, excluding those with surgical scars for renal, ureteric, and urinary bladder surgery, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, malignancies, abdominopelvic irradiation, or less than 6 months follow-up.
finding: Operated adhesive postoperative intestinal obstruction has a high incidence and specific risk factors for recurrence, including age <40 years, presence of adhesion or matted adhesion, and postoperative surgical complications.
mod_finding: Lower segment caesarean section was a major cause of postoperative adhesive intestinal obstruction.
